article_content: Washington (CNN) -- The federal government will ease restrictions on U.S. relations with Cuba within two weeks, according to a statement from the White House released on Friday. 'Today, President Obama has directed the secretaries of State, Treasury, and Homeland Security to take a series of steps to continue efforts to reach out to the Cuban people in support of their desire to freely determine their country's future,' the White House stated. The changes concern travel, non-family remittances, and U.S. airports supporting licensed charter flights to and from Cuba. 'These measures will increase people-to-people contact; support civil society in Cuba; enhance the free flow of information to, from, and among the Cuban people; and help promote their independence from Cuban authorities,' the statement continued. 'The president believes these actions, combined with the continuation of the embargo, are important steps in reaching the widely shared goal of a Cuba that respects the basic rights of all its citizens.' Under the new regulations, religious organizations can sponsor religious travel to the island, and institutions of higher education can sponsor travel for course work for academic credit -- both under a general license. Additionally, licensing of educational exchanges not involving academic study pursuant to a degree program will be restored. Specifically licensed academic institutions will be able to sponsor academic seminars, conferences, and workshops related to Cuba, allowing faculty, staff, and students to attend. Licensing will also be allowed for a greater scope of journalistic activities. Furthermore, any U.S. person will be able to send up to $500 every three months to non-family members in Cuba, 'subject to the limitation that they cannot be provided to senior Cuban government officials or senior members of the Cuban Communist Party.' Obama also directed that any U.S. international airport can apply to service licensed charters, 'provided such airports have adequate customs and immigration capabilities and a licensed travel service provider has expressed an interest in providing service to and from Cuba from that airport.' Rep. Ileana Ros-Lehtinen, R-Florida, dismissed the move toward rapprochement. 'These changes will not help better human rights nor will they help Cubans free themselves of the tyranny that surrounds them,' she stated. 'The changes will just bring economic benefits to the Cuban regime.' 'That's really absurd,' responded Wayne Smith, former chief of the U.S. Interests Section in Havana, in a telephone interview with CNN from Washington, where he directs the Center for International Policy's Cuba Program. He described the changes as 'terrific,' but said the administration should go further by ending the half-century-old trade embargo. 'It really hasn't done the slightest bit of good,' he said. 'Our whole policy has to be called a failure. It has not forced the Cubans to change. The best thing we can do is to have greater contact with the Cubans, a greater flow of people and ideas and so forth. You can have more impact that way than by trying to wall everybody off.' Smith noted that his group this week announced plans to hold a conference next week calling on the administration to lift the restrictions on academic travel and people-to-people travel, and a series of other steps. 'So, we'll take full credit,' he said, laughing. 'We called on them to do it and, by golly, they have.' He added, 'I wish they'd done it months ago, but better late than never.' CNN's Arthur Brice and Tom Watkins contributed to this story.
translated_content: Vašington (CNN) -- Federalna vlada će u roku od dve nedelje olabaviti ograničenja u odnosima SAD i Kube, prema izjavi Bele kuće objavljenoj u petak. 'Danas je predsednik Obama naložio sekretarima za državu, finansije i unutrašnju bezbednost da preduzmu niz koraka kako bi nastavili napore da se približe kubanskom narodu u podršci njihovoj želji da slobodno odrede budućnost svoje zemlje', saopštila je Bela kuća. Promene se tiču putovanja, neporodičnih novčanih pošiljki i aerodroma u SAD koji podržavaju čarter letove za Kubu i sa Kube. 'Ove mere će povećati kontakte među ljudima; podržati građansko društvo na Kubi; poboljšati slobodan protok informacija ka, od i među kubanskim narodom; i pomoći u promociji njihove nezavisnosti od kubanskih vlasti', navodi se u saopštenju. 'Predsednik veruje da su ove akcije, u kombinaciji sa nastavkom embarga, važni koraci ka postizanju široko deljenog cilja Kube koja poštuje osnovna prava svih svojih građana.' Prema novim propisima, verske organizacije mogu sponzorisati verska putovanja na ostrvo, a visokoobrazovne institucije mogu sponzorisati putovanja za obavljanje nastavnih zadataka za sticanje akademskih kredita -- oboje po opštem dozvolama. Pored toga, dozvoljavanje obrazovnih razmena koje ne uključuju akademsko studiranje u skladu sa programom diplome će biti obnovljeno. Specifično licencirane akademske institucije će moći da sponzorišu akademske seminare, konferencije i radionice vezane za Kubu, omogućavajući nastavnicima, osoblju i studentima da prisustvuju. 'Dozvoljavanje će biti omogućeno i za širi opseg novinarskih aktivnosti. Nadalje, bilo koji građanin SAD će moći da pošalje do 500 dolara svaka tri meseca nepovezanim članovima porodice na Kubi, 'uz ograničenje da se ne mogu davati visokim kubanskim vladinim funkcionerima ili visokim članovima Kubanske komunističke partije.' Obama je takođe naredio da bilo koji međunarodni aerodrom u SAD može da se prijavi za usluge licenciranih čartera, 'uz uslov da takvi aerodromi imaju adekvatne carinske i imigracione sposobnosti i da je licencirani pružaoc usluga putovanja izrazio interesovanje za pružanje usluga za i sa Kube sa tog aerodroma.' Zastupnica Ileana Ros-Lehtinen, R-Florida, odbacila je pomeranje ka približavanju. 'Ove promene neće pomoći u poboljšanju ljudskih prava niti će pomoći Kubancima da se oslobode tiranije koja ih okružuje', rekla je. 'Promene će samo doneti ekonomske beneficije kubanskom režimu.' 'To je zaista apsurdno', odgovorio je Vejn Smit, bivši šef Odeljenja za interese SAD u Havani, u telefonskom intervjuu sa CNN-om iz Vašingtona, gde vodi Program za Kubu Centra za međunarodnu politiku. Opisao je promene kao 'fantastične', ali je rekao da administracija treba da ide dalje ukidanjem embargoa koji traje pola veka. 'To zaista nije donelo nimalo dobrog', rekao je. 'Cela naša politika mora da se nazove neuspehom. Nije natjerala Kubance da se promene. Najbolje što možemo učiniti jeste da imamo veći kontakt sa Kubancima, veći protok ljudi i ideja i tako dalje. Možete imati veći uticaj na taj način nego pokušavajući da sve zatvorite.' Smit je napomenuo da je njegova grupa ove nedelje najavila planove za održavanje konferencije sledeće nedelje pozivajući administraciju da ukinu ograničenja za akademska putovanja i putovanja između ljudi, i niz drugih koraka. 'Tako da, uzmemo puno zasluga', rekao je smejajući se. 'Pozvali smo ih da to urade i, bogom, uradili su.' Dodao je, 'Želeo bih da su to uradili mesecima ranije, ali bolje kasno nego nikada.' Arthur Brice i Tom Watkins sa CNN-om doprineli su ovom članku.

article_content: A massive road, rail, and house-building program worth £100 billion is to be unveiled by the government tomorrow. George Osborne promised significant new investment in infrastructure projects, spending £50 billion every year until 2020. However, Labour dismissed the package as a 'con', claiming there was no new money and that budgets were actually being cut. Dig for victory: George Osborne boasted that the government was ordering a record-breaking investment in construction projects, including rail, roads, and homes. Clash: Labour's shadow chancellor Ed Balls accused Mr. Osborne of a 'con', stating that funding on capital spending was falling in real terms. The government is pinning its hopes on securing the economic recovery by diverting money into large-scale construction projects. Ministers will tomorrow unveil details of billions of pounds of road and rail upgrades, new energy projects including investment in nuclear and renewables, and thousands of new affordable homes. Mr. Osborne told the Commons: 'Successive governments of all colours have put short-term pressures over the long-term needs and refused to commit to capital spending plans that match the horizons of a modern economy. Today we change that. We commit now to £50 billion of capital investment in 2015. From roads to railways, bridges to broadband, science to schools... it will amount to over £300 billion of capital spending guaranteed to the end of this decade.' However, Labour dismissed the statement as a 'con', pointing out that there was no new money for infrastructure. The £50 billion capital spending announced for 2015-16 amounted to a 1.7 percent cut in real terms, Labour claimed. Shadow chancellor Ed Balls said: 'They have done nothing – zero. It's a complete capital spending con. There is nothing here.' In March, the government pledged £300 billion of capital spending by 2020. Mr. Osborne said the first £50 billion would be spent in 2015-16, the year covered by the spending review. That was more on average as a proportion of national income over the decade than between 2000 and 2010, he said, as he sought to counter criticisms that he has failed to do enough to spur growth. Chief Secretary to the Treasury Danny Alexander will tomorrow give details of where the first £100 billion of the £300 billion total will be spent. The Department for Transport capital budget has been boosted to a guaranteed £9.5 billion a year for the rest of the decade. Mr. Osborne said this would pay for the biggest investment in roads for 50 years and 'the largest investment in our railways since the Victorian age'. Mayor of London Boris Johnson welcomed a big boost - a grant of £925 million in 2015/16 rising to just over £1 billion by 2020/21 on top of enhanced borrowing powers to fund transport in the capital. Science - an area the Government has been accused of neglecting - will see its capital budget increase from £0.6 billion to £1.1 billion as part of a 9 percent rise in capital investment at the Department of Business Innovation and Skills. Mr. Osborne also outlined commitments to new flood defenses. Capital funding for education would be £4.6 billion in 2015-16 - part of a £21 billion package over the 2015-2020 parliament - which would 'tackle the backlog of maintenance in existing schools and invest in new school places', he indicated. And there would be £3 billion capital investment in affordable housing. John Cridland, CBI Director-General, said: 'Infrastructure is rightly singled out as the most effective engine for growth, as we urged. While the Government talks a good game on infrastructure, we've seen too little delivery on the ground so far. It is critical we see a real pipeline of projects announced tomorrow, so investors know what schemes are going ahead, where and when.' Institution of Civil Engineers director general, Nick Baveystock, said: 'The severe infrastructure investment cuts made in the 2010 spending review have begun to bite and are undermining the sector's ability to stimulate growth or job creation, so we are encouraged to see a review with actual infrastructure investment at its heart. The increase in capital expenditure and funding certainty for key programs appears to be positive news and could provide a platform for the industry to deliver on national needs more effectively. It is, however, not all good news for infrastructure. Departmental cuts will inevitably place further pressure on local authority budgets, with road maintenance likely to suffer the brunt.'
translated_content: Masivni program izgradnje puteva, železnica i stambenih objekata vredan 100 milijardi funti biće predstavljen od strane vlade sutra. Džordž Osborn je obećao značajna nova ulaganja u infrastrukturne projekte, trošeći 50 milijardi funti svake godine do 2020. Međutim, Laburisti su odbacili paket kao 'prevaru', tvrdeći da nema novog novca i da se budžeti zapravo smanjuju. Kopajte za pobedom: Džordž Osborn se hvalio da vlada naručuje rekordno ulaganje u građevinske projekte, uključujući železnice, puteve i domove. Sudar: Senka laburističkog kancelara Ed Bols optužio je gospodina Osborna za 'prevaru', tvrdeći da se finansiranje kapitalnih rashoda smanjuje u realnim uslovima. Vlada polaže nade na obezbeđivanje ekonomskog oporavka usmeravanjem novca u velike građevinske projekte. Ministri će sutra otkriti detalje o milijardama funti ulaganja u nadogradnju puteva i železnica, nove energetske projekte uključujući ulaganja u nuklearnu energiju i obnovljive izvore energije i hiljade novih pristupačnih stanova. Gospodin Osborn je rekao Komorama: 'Uzastopne vlade svih boja stavljale su kratkoročne pritiske iznad dugoročnih potreba i odbijale da se obavežu na planove kapitalnih rashoda koji odgovaraju horizontima moderne ekonomije. Danas to menjamo. Sada se obavezujemo na 50 milijardi funti kapitalnih ulaganja 2015. Od puteva do železnica, mostova do širokopojasnog interneta, nauke do škola ... iznosiće se na preko 300 milijardi funti kapitalnih rashoda garantovanih do kraja ove dekade.' Međutim, Laburisti su odbacili izjavu kao 'prevaru', ukazujući da nema novog novca za infrastrukturu. Kapitalna ulaganja od 50 milijardi funti najavljena za 2015-16 iznosila su 1,7 procenata manje u realnim uslovima, tvrdili su Laburisti. Senka kancelara Ed Bols rekao je: 'Nisu uradili ništa – nula. To je potpuna prevara kapitalnih rashoda. Ovde nema ništa.' U martu, vlada se obavezala na 300 milijardi funti kapitalnih rashoda do 2020. Gospodin Osborn je rekao da će se prva od 50 milijardi funti potrošiti 2015-16, godina koju pokriva pregled troškova. To je više u proseku kao deo nacionalnog prihoda tokom dekade nego između 2000. i 2010., rekao je, dok je nastojao da ospori kritike da nije učinio dovoljno da podstakne rast. Glavni sekretar riznice Deni Aleksandar će sutra dati detalje o tome gde će biti potrošena prva od 100 milijardi funti od ukupno 300 milijardi. Budžet za kapitalne rashode Ministarstva saobraćaja povećan je na garantovana 9,5 milijardi funti godišnje do kraja dekade. Gospodin Osborn je rekao da će ovo platiti najveće ulaganje u puteve za 50 godina i 'najveće ulaganje u naše železnice još od viktorijanskog doba'. Gradonačelnik Londona Boris Džonson pozdravio je veliko povećanje - doprinos od 925 miliona funti 2015/16 koji raste na malo preko 1 milijarde funti do 2020/21 uz povećana ovlašćenja za zaduživanje za finansiranje prevoza u glavnom gradu. Nauka - oblast koju je Vlada optužena da zanemaruje - videće povećanje svog kapitalnog budžeta sa 0,6 milijarde na 1,1 milijarde funti kao deo porasta kapitalnih ulaganja od 9 procenata u Ministarstvu za biznis, inovacije i veštine. Gospodin Osborn je takođe naveo obaveze za nove odbrambene nasipe od poplava. Kapitalno finansiranje za obrazovanje biće 4,6 milijardi funti 2015-16 - deo paketa od 21 milijarde funti tokom parlamenta 2015-2020 - što će 'rešiti zaostatak u održavanju postojećih škola i ulagati u nova školska mesta', ukazao je. I biće 3 milijarde funti kapitalnih ulaganja u pristupačno stanovanje. Džon Kridland, generalni direktor CBI, rekao je: 'Infrastruktura je na pravom mestu istaknuta kao najefikasniji motor rasta, kako smo i tražili. Iako Vlada dobro govori o infrastrukturi, dosad smo videli premalo ostvarenja na terenu. Kritično je da sutra vidimo pravi niz projekata, tako da investitori znaju koji projekti idu napred, gde i kada.' Direktor generalne institucije građevinskih inženjera, Nik Bejvistok, rekao je: 'Oštri rezovi ulaganja u infrastrukturu iz 2010. godine počeli su da se osećaju i podrivaju sposobnost sektora da stimuliše rast ili stvaranje poslova, pa smo ohrabreni da vidimo pregled sa stvarnim ulaganjem u infrastrukturu u srcu. Povećanje kapitalnih rashoda i sigurnost finansiranja za ključne programe čini se dobrom vesti i moglo bi pružiti platformu industriji da bolje zadovolji nacionalne potrebe. Međutim, to nije sve dobre vesti za infrastrukturu. Rezovi odeljenja neizbežno će stvoriti dodatni pritisak na budžete lokalne uprave, a održavanje puteva verovatno će pretrpeti najveći udar.'

article_content: Angel Di Maria is on the verge of a monumental transfer to Manchester United for a staggering £75 million, and he attributes his remarkable journey to his daughter, Mia. Mia, now 16 months old, was born three months premature and faced severe health complications that kept her in intensive care for weeks. Doctors were unsure if she would survive, making it an extremely challenging time for Di Maria and his wife, Jorgelina Cardoso. Against all odds, Mia pulled through and is now a healthy, happy child. Her resilience has been a profound inspiration for Di Maria, driving him to excel on the football field. In an interview with the Spanish newspaper Marca, Di Maria shared, 'My daughter has shown me that anything is possible. She's taught me that the toughest challenges can sometimes be the easiest to overcome, and that hard work pays off.' Di Maria's outstanding performances for Real Madrid and his contributions to Argentina's World Cup campaign caught the attention of Manchester United. Despite an injury that forced him out of the World Cup final, his talent has made him a highly sought-after player. Manchester United is eager to secure his skills to bolster their team. Di Maria's decision to join Manchester United is fully supported by his wife, Jorgelina, who is known for her outspokenness on social media. She often defends her husband against critics and shares heartwarming family photos on her Instagram account. In a post celebrating Mia's first birthday, Jorgelina reflected on the emotional rollercoaster they endured during Mia's early days, expressing gratitude for the medical staff who saved their daughter's life. Di Maria echoed his wife's sentiments, praising the hospital staff and the bonds they formed with other parents facing similar struggles. He told The Sun, 'The pain unites people. It makes you stronger.' Despite the challenges, Di Maria's perseverance has led him to this pivotal moment in his career, with his family cheering him on every step of the way.

Di Marija je ponovio osećanja svoje supruge, hvaleći bolničko osoblje i veze koje su uspostavili sa drugim roditeljima koji se suočavaju sa sličnim izazovima. Rekao je za The Sun, 'Bol čini ljude jačima.' Usprkos izazovima, di Marijina upornost dovela ga je do ovog presudnog trenutka u njegovoj karijeri, sa porodicom koja ga ohrabruje na svakom koraku.

article_content: Click here for all the stats and heat maps from the game at the Veltins-Arena. John O’Shea now has one hundred caps and three goals for the Republic of Ireland. As Martin O’Neill and his team edge towards an unlikely shot at qualification for the European Championship finals, that second statistic is currently more important than the first. Only seconds remained in added time in Gelsenkirchen on Tuesday night as Ireland seemed to be heading to a rather expected and routine defeat against a German team that was unimpressive but still markedly superior. Ireland defender John O'Shea (No 4) runs off in celebration followed by Stephen Ward (No 2) and Jon Walters (No 19). O'Shea (centre) celebrates with his delighted Irish team-mates after securing an unexpected point against world champions Germany. O'Shea looks up into the crowd as he celebrates—Irish fans were spotted all over the stadium in Gelsenkirchen. O'Shea, celebrating his 100th cap, gets in ahead of defender Mats Hummels to sweep home. Keeper Manuel Neuer kicks the ball out of the net as O'Shea (background) wheels away in celebration at the shock equaliser. O'Shea gets a grip of Ward as his fellow defender almost takes a tumble in the aftermath of the late leveller. Real Madrid midfielder Toni Kroos (No 18) roars in celebration after opening the scoring from 25 yards. Kroos' shot goes beyond David Forde in the Ireland goal to give Germany what looked to be all three points in Group D. Kroos waves to the crowd as German team-mates look relieved; but it didn't last as the world champions conceded late on. Ireland's (from left) Darron Gibson, O'Shea, Stephen Quinn and Marc Wilson look gutted after Kroos' goal with 20 minutes left. It was Germany's turn to look shell-shocked when Ireland scored—Mario Gotze head in hands and Thomas Muller (No 13) stunned. Germany (4-2-3-1) Neuer 6; Rudiger 6, Boateng 6, Hummels 6.5, Durm 6.5; Ginter 6.5 (Podolski 45, 6.5), Kroos 6.5; Bellarabi 6 (Rudy 86), Gotze 6, Draxler 5.5 (Kruse 70); Muller 6.5. Goals: Kroos 70. Booked: Hummels. Republic of Ireland (4-4-2) Forde 7; Meyler 6.5, O’Shea 7.5, Wilson 7, Ward 6.5; McGeady 5.5, Quinn 5.5 (Hoolahan 76, 6), Whelan 6 (Hendrick 54, 6), McClean 6; Keane 5 (Gibson 62, 6), Walters 5. Goals: O'Shea 70. Booked: Whelan, Wilson. Referee: Damir Skomina 7. Man of the match: John O’Shea. Ratings by Ian Ladyman at the Veltins-Arena. Toni Kroos had scored his team’s goal with 20 minutes to go and, for Ireland, there seemed to be no coming back. O’Shea, however, had been a stalwart at centre-half all night and, when it mattered, he appeared just an inch or two ahead of Germany’s Mats Hummels to prod an unlikely equaliser past Manuel Neuer after a deep cross from substitute Wes Hoolahan had been hooked back across goal deep in the 94th minute. It really was a most incredible finish. O’Shea’s last goal for his country had come against Kazakhstan. Suffice to say, this one may transpire to be much more important. Having not lost back-to-back competitive games since the European Championship finals hosted by Holland and Belgium 14 years ago, Germany were clearly intent on making amends for their setback across the Polish border at the weekend. For much of the first half, their football was purposeful and aggressive. For long periods, though, there was not much to show for it once play reached the environs of the Irish penalty area. Indeed, Irish goalkeeper Forde was worked only twice in an opening 45 minutes that saw O’Neill’s team hold the Germans at bay with relative comfort. Certainly Ireland were organised and not lacking in energy themselves. O’Shea and Marc Wilson were particularly impressive immediately in front of Forde even if the Irish largely failed to hold on to the ball whenever they did manage to venture into the German half. A team unrecognisable in part to the one that lifted the World Cup in Rio back in early July, Germany nevertheless bristled with attacking menace at the outset. Indeed, only five minutes had elapsed when left-back Erik Durm advanced to smack a superb right foot volley into the top of the crossbar from 25 yards. For a while this effort seemed to set the tone as the German midfield eased the Irish defence so far towards their own goal that, at times, as many as six green shirts retreated to form some kind of shield in front of Forde. Thousands of Irish fans travelled to watch their team pick up their seventh point in three games in Group D qualifying. Irish fans were in raptures after O'Shea's equaliser, with one German (centre) looking particularly out of place among green shirts. Substitute Podolski appeals for a penalty after Wilson appeared to bring him down, but the referee waved play on. Germany defender Antonio Rudiger had a free header early on but his attempt went wide of the target. James McClean goes in with a hefty challenge on Julian Draxler in the middle of the pitch, but no free-kick is awarded to the Germans. One rare Ireland attack ended with Bayern keeper Neuer grabbing the ball low just ahead of Robbie Keane. article_content: For many English football enthusiasts, it wasn't coffee or bananas that brought Costa Rica to their attention, but rather Paulo Wanchope. In April 1997, during his debut for Derby County, Wanchope collected the ball in his own half and dashed towards the Stretford End, leaving Phil Neville behind. He covered 60 yards before effortlessly rolling the ball past Peter Schmeichel, securing a 3-2 victory for Derby against Manchester United. This stunning performance left Old Trafford in awe and sparked curiosity about the small Central American nation. Within months, Wanchope found himself in the company of the Queen and embarked on a decade-long global football journey that took him to London, Manchester, Spain, Qatar, Argentina, Japan, and the United States. Today, Wanchope serves as the assistant manager of the Costa Rica national team, strategizing for the World Cup where they are grouped with England, Italy, and Uruguay. 'It was quite surprising when we saw the draw,' Wanchope remarked. 'We knew it would be challenging, but facing three former champions is a huge deal for us. Our country will come to a standstill, with everyone eagerly awaiting the matches against England and Italy.' Wanchope, still lean and athletic despite six knee operations, reflects on how his move to England transformed his life. 'It changed everything,' he said. 'Memories like the United game and moving to Pride Park stand out. Meeting the Queen when she opened the stadium was unforgettable.' His journey began with a trial at QPR, where he impressed but didn't secure a contract initially. Later, he joined Derby, unaware of its location but quickly won over by the club's atmosphere under managers Jim Smith and Steve McClaren. Wanchope's fluency in English, gained from his time in the US, aided his integration. After successful stints at Derby, Wanchope played for West Ham, Manchester City, and several international clubs. He earned 73 caps for Costa Rica, scoring 45 goals, before purchasing a second-tier club, Club Sport Uruguay. His coaching ambitions led him back to the national team, where he hopes to one day become a head coach. Under Colombian coach Jorge Luis Pinto, Costa Rica aims to replicate their Italia '90 success. 'We want to emulate that performance,' Wanchope said. 'The world expects England, Italy, and Uruguay to advance, but we aim to reach the second stage.' Costa Rica's hopes rest on players like Bryan Ruiz and Joel Campbell, who have experience in European leagues. Ruiz, on loan at PSV Eindhoven, and Campbell, who scored against Manchester United in the Champions League, are crucial to the team's strategy. Preparing in Colorado and Florida, Costa Rica faces challenges like high temperatures but remains optimistic. 'Tactically, we have improved,' Wanchope noted. 'With players like Ruiz and Campbell, we can always score.'
translated_content: Za mnoge engleske ljubitelje fudbala, nije kafa ili banane dovela Kostariku u centar pažnje, već Paulo Vančop. U aprilu 1997. godine, tokom svog debija za Derbi Kaunti, Vančop je uzeo loptu u svojoj polovini i pojurio ka Strettford Endu, ostavljajući Fila Nevila iza sebe. Prešao je 60 jardi prije nego što je lako uvaljao loptu pored Pitera Šmajhela, osiguravajući pobedu Derbija nad Mančester Junajtedom od 3-2. Ova neverovatna izvedba ostavila je Old Traford u oduševljenju i probudila radoznalost o maloj centralnoameričkoj naciji. Za nekoliko meseci, Vančop se našao u društvu kraljice i započeo desetogodišnje globalno fudbalsko putovanje koje ga je odvelo u London, Mančester, Španiju, Katar, Argentinu, Japan i Sjedinjene Države. Danas, Vančop služi kao pomoćni menadžer reprezentacije Kostarike, strategizujući za Svetsko prvenstvo gde su grupisani sa Engleskom, Italijom i Urugvajem. 'Bilo je prilično iznenađujuće kada smo videli izvlačenje', primetio je Vančop. 'Znali smo da će biti teško, ali suočavati se sa tri bivša šampiona je ogromna stvar za nas. Naša zemlja će stati, sa svima koji ne mogu da dočekaju utakmice protiv Engleske i Italije.' Vančop, i dalje vitak i atletski uprkos šest operacija kolena, razmišlja o tome kako mu se preseljenje u Englesku promenilo život. 'Promenilo je sve', rekao je. 'Sećanja poput utakmice sa Junajtedom i selidbe na Prajd Park se ističu. Upotreba sa kraljicom kada je otvorila stadion bila je nezaboravna.' Njegovo putovanje počelo je probom u KPR, gde je impresionirao ali nije osigurao ugovor na početku. Kasnije se pridružio Derbiju, ne znajući njegovu lokaciju, ali brzo osvojen atmosferom kluba pod menadžerima Džimom Smitom i Stivom Maklerenom. Vančopova tečnost na engleskom, stečena tokom boravka u SAD, pomogla mu je u integraciji. Nakon uspešnih perioda u Derbiju, Vančop je igrao za Vest Hem, Mančester Siti i nekoliko internacionalnih klubova. Osvojio je 73 nastupa za Kostariku, postigavši 45 golova, pre nego što je kupio klub druge lige, Klub Sport Urugvaj. Njegove trenerske ambicije vratile su ga u nacionalni tim, gde nada da će jednog dana postati glavni trener. Pod kolumbijskim trenerom Horheom Luisom Pintom, Kostarika teži da ponovi svoj uspeh na Italiji '90. 'Želimo da ponovimo tu izvedbu', rekao je Vančop. 'Svet očekuje da će Engleska, Italija i Urugvaj proći, ali mi težimo da stignemo do druge faze.' Nade Kostarike počivaju na igracima poput Brajana Ruiza i Džoela Kembelja, koji imaju iskustvo u evropskim ligama. Ruiz, na pozajmici u PSV Ajndhovenu, i Kembel, koji je postigao gol protiv Mančester Junajteda u Ligi šampiona, ključni su za strategiju tima. Pripremajući se u Koloradu i Floridi, Kostarika se suočava sa izazovima poput visokih temperatura, ali ostaje optimistična. 'Taktički smo se poboljšali', napomenuo je Vančop. 'Sa igracima poput Ruiza i Kembelja, uvek možemo da postignemo gol.'

article_content: By Daily Mail Reporter. PUBLISHED: 17:21 EST, 12 June 2013. UPDATED: 17:39 EST, 12 June 2013. Warren Buffett, the 82-year-old who was named the world's third wealthiest person in 2012, has a right-hand woman: a 28-year-old Harvard graduate who some say is being groomed to take over from Buffett when he retires. Tracy Britt began working for Buffett in 2009 as a financial assistant, and in four short years has become a trusted confidante of the billionaire and chairwoman of four of his companies, which bring in $4 billion combined annually. In 2007, in a letter to shareholders, Buffett announced that he was looking for a younger successor, or perhaps successors, to run his investment business. Speculation is mounting that Britt is that successor. Like other Buffett lieutenants, Britt was plucked from relative obscurity to rise through the ranks of Berkshire Hathaway, the company of which Buffett is chairman, CEO, and primary shareholder. Britt grew up in Manhattan, Kansas, where her parents ran Britt's Garden Acres, growing fruit, vegetables, and flowers. It wasn't Wall Street, but this is where Britt honed her business skills and developed her work ethic. 'Every minute that I had to work on the farm, I hated it,' she told Harvard Magazine in 2007, describing being stuck on the phone with distributors during summer holidays. 'But it actually shaped my dedication, my work ethic, and the way I follow through on the commitments I have made,' she said. Britt went to Harvard and then on to Harvard Business School, against the advice of many around her. 'I had to drown out a great deal of unsolicited advice saying that I absolutely must work before going to business school. I was told again and again that I didn't have sufficient experience, I wasn't prepared, and I was downright crazy to think that anyone would hire me in the investing field straight from business school,' wrote Britt on Lean In. Since he hired Britt in 2009, Warren Buffett has gradually added responsibilities to her role, and now she 'takes care of all kinds of things that come up' Buffett told college students in Omaha last month. 'During one of my classes, we were assigned to write a hypothetical personal reflection for our 10-year reunion. Mine... included this sentence: My goal is to work with a great investor, who even more importantly is a wonderful teacher and mentor. After reading my thoughts, one of my classmates – an individual who worked for large investment firms for several years before business school – told me that I was naïve and as a direct admit, I wasn't aware of what the real world was like and that after I worked a few years, I'd realize just how unrealistic my personal reflection was,' she continued. But Britt received the 'wonderful teacher and mentor' of her dreams, and according to the Washington Post, has an office next door to her boss's. She also helps with financial research and accompanies Buffett to meetings. In March after Berkshire and Brazilian investment firm 3G Capital announced they would buy ketchup maker H.J. Heinz & Co. for $23 billion, Buffett sent Britt to Brazil. According to the Washington Post, he wanted Britt to be familiar with 3G's operations. 'She's got this wealth of information about what's going on at the Berkshire portfolio companies,' Sam Taylor, chief executive of Oriental Trading Co. told the Washington Post. 'She knows exactly what's going on and where Warren's head is at.' Buffett first met Britt when she and a fellow graduate founded Smart Woman Securities, a not-for-profit organization focused on investment education for undergraduate women in 2006. She contacted Buffett asking if he would meet with her members at his company's headquarters in Omaha, and amazingly, he agreed. Buffett has written about his belief that there should be more women in business, and has said that he believes women are key to America's prosperity. 'The moment I emerged from my mother's womb... my possibilities dwarfed those of my siblings, for I was a boy! And my brainy, personable, and good-looking siblings were not,' he wrote in Fortune magazine. 'So my floor became my sisters' ceiling - and nobody thought much about ripping up that pattern until a few decades ago. Now, thank heavens, the structural barriers for women are falling.' During her undergraduate studies Britt served as president of Harvard Undergraduate Women in Business and continued to work on her parents' farm during summers. As a junior, she interned at 85 Broads in New York City, a global women's networking organization. There, she was taken under the wing of a woman who worked in the hedge-fund industry. 'She provided me with the guidance necessary to navigate the industry, as well as the insight and confidence to be successful in finance,' said Britt in Harvard Magazine. 'In an industry dominated by males, it is hard to break in if you don't know somebody or aren't the type of person to get out there and push in.' The organization was impressed with Britt, too: Janet Hanson, the founder of 85 Broads, remembers Ms. Britt from her internship. 'She had some sort of internal guiding system that was propelling her forward,' Ms. Hanson told the Washington Post. 'She was on rocket fuel... this was a gal who was going to get what she wanted.' Britt says she always knew she wanted to be involved in investments and got a taste for business dealing with distributors on her parents' farm. Britt's next meeting with Buffett was when she was fresh out of business school in 2009, when she brought a bushel of sweet corn and fresh tomatoes from her parents' farm to her meeting with the businessman. Following this meeting, she was made Buffett's financial assistant and has gone from strength to strength. 'I intend to hire a younger man or woman with the potential to manage a very large portfolio, who we hope will succeed me as Berkshire's chief investment officer when the need for someone to do that arises,' Buffett wrote in a letter to shareholders in 2007. 'As part of the selection process, we may in fact take on several candidates.' In May, Buffett announced at the annual Berkshire Hathaway shareholder meeting that he knows who his successor is, but he declined to name the person or persons. But one thing is for sure: Tracy Britt is destined for great things - especially with a mentor like Buffett. 'Fellow males, get on board. The closer that America comes to fully employing the talents of all its citizens, the greater its output of goods and services will be,' he wrote in Fortune magazine. 'We've seen what can be accomplished when we use 50 per cent of our human capacity. If you visualize what 100 per cent can do, you'll join me as an unbridled optimist about America's future.'

Voren Bafet, 82-godišnjak koji je 2012. proglašen trećim najbogatijim čovekom na svetu, ima desnu ruku: 28-godišnju diplomku sa Harvarda, za koju neki kažu da se priprema da preuzme od Bafeta kada se penzioniše. Trejsi Brit je počela da radi za Bafeta 2009. kao finansijski asistent, i za četiri kratke godine postala je poverljiva saradnica milijardera i predsednica četiri njegove kompanije, koje zajedno donose 4 milijarde dolara godišnje. 2007. godine, u pismu akcionarima, Bafet je objavio da traži mlađeg naslednika, ili možda naslednike, da vode njegov investicioni biznis. Špekulacije rastu da je Brit taj naslednik. Kao i drugi Bafetovi poručnici, Brit je izvučena iz relativne nepoznatosti da bi se uzdigla kroz redove Berkshire Hathaway, kompanije čiji je Bafet predsednik, izvršni direktor i glavni akcionar. Brit je odrasla u Manhetenu, Kanzas, gde su njeni roditelji vodili Britovu baštu akara, uzgajajući voće, povrće i cveće. To nije Vol Strit, ali ovo je mesto gde je Brit usavršila svoje poslovne veštine i razvila svoju radnu etiku. 'Svaku minutu koju sam morala da radim na farmi, mrzela sam', rekla je za Harvard Magazine 2007. godine, opisujući kako je bila zaglavljena na telefonu sa distributerima tokom letnjih praznika. 'Ali to je zapravo oblikovalo moju posvećenost, moju radnu etiku i način na koji ispunjavam obaveze koje sam preuzela', rekla je. Brit je otišla na Harvard, a zatim na Harvard Business School, uprkos savetima mnogih oko nje. 'Morala sam da utišam mnogo nesolicitiranih saveta koji su govorili da moram da radim pre nego što idem na poslovnu školu. Govorili su mi opet i opet da nemam dovoljno iskustva, da nisam spremna i da sam potpuno luda ako mislim da će me netko angažovati u investicionom polju odmah nakon poslovne škole', napisala je Brit na Lean In. Od kada ju je angažovao 2009. godine, Voren Bafet je postepeno dodavao odgovornosti njenoj ulozi, i sada ona 'brine se o svemu što se pojavi' rekao je Bafet studentskim kolegama u Omahi prošlog meseca. 'Tokom jednog od mojih časova, dobili smo zadatak da napišemo hipotetičnu ličnu refleksiju za našu 10-godišnjicu. Moja... uključivala je ovu rečenicu: Moj cilj je da radim sa velikim investitorom, što je još važnije, čudnim učiteljem i mentorom. Nakon što je pročitao moje misli, jedan od mojih kolega iz razreda – osoba koja je radila za velike investicione firme nekoliko godina pre poslovne škole – rekao mi je da sam naivna i da kao direktni prijemnik nisam svesna kako stvarni svet izgleda i da ću, nakon što neko vreme radim, shvatiti koliko je moja lična refleksija nerealna', nastavila je. Ali Brit je dobila 'čudnog učitelja i mentora' svojih snova, i prema Vašington Postu, ima kancelariju pored kancelarije svog šefa. Takođe pomaže u finansijskim istraživanjima i prati Bafeta na sastancima. U martu, nakon što su Berkshire i brazilska investiciona firma 3G Capital objavili da će kupiti proizvođača kečapa H.J. Heinz & Co. za 23 milijarde dolara, Bafet je poslao Brit u Brazil. Prema Vašington Postu, hteo je da Brit bude upoznata sa operacijama 3G. 'Oni imaju to bogatstvo informacija o tome što se dešava u portfelju kompanija Berkshire', rekao je Sem Tejlor, izvršni direktor Oriental Trading Co., za Vašington Post. 'Oni znamo tačno šta se dešava i gde je Vorena glava.' Bafet je prvi put upoznao Brit kada je ona i kolega diplomac osnovali Smart Woman Securities, neprofitnu organizaciju usmerenu na investiciono obrazovanje za studentkinje 2006. godine. Obratila se Bafetu pitajući da li bi se sastao sa njenim članovima u sedištu njegove kompanije u Omahi, i čudno, on je pristao. Bafet je pisao o svojem verovanju da bi trebalo da bude više žena u biznisu i rekao je da veruje da su žene ključ američkom prosperitetu. 'U trenutku kada sam izašao iz materine utrobe... mogućnosti su me zasenile, jer sam bio dečak! A moji pametni, prijatni i lepi brat i sestra nisu bili', napisao je u Fortune magazinu. 'Tako da je moj pod postao plafon moje sestre - i niko nije mnogo razmišljao o kidanju tog uzorka sve do nekoliko decenija unazad. Sada, hvala nebesima, strukturne barijere za žene padaju.' Tokom svojih preddiplomskih studija, Brit je služila kao predsednica Harvard Undergraduate Women in Business i nastavila da radi na farmi svojih roditelja tokom leta. Kao junior, praktikovala je u 85 Broads u Njujorku, globalnoj ženskoj mrežnoj organizaciji. Tamo je bila uzeta pod zaštitu žene koja je radila u industriji hedž fondova. 'Pružila mi je vodstvo potrebno da navigiram industrijom, kao i uvid i samopouzdanje da budem uspešna u finansijama', rekla je Brit u Harvard Magazine. 'U industriji kojom dominiraju muškarci, teško je ući ako ne poznaješ nekoga ili nisi tip osobe koja će izaći i potisnuti.' Organizacija je bila impresionirana Brit, takođe: Džanet Hanson, osnivačica 85 Broads, seća se gđe. Brit sa njene prakse. 'Imala je neku vrstu internog navođenog sistema koji ju je gurao napred', rekla je gđa. Hanson za Vašington Post. 'Bila je na raketnom gorivu... ovo je devojka koja će dobiti ono što želi.' Brit kaže da je uvek znala da želi da bude uključena u investicije i dobila je ukus za biznis radeći sa distributerima na farmi svojih roditelja. Britin sledeći sastanak sa Bafetom bio je kada je tek završila poslovnu školu 2009. godine, kada je donela korpu slatkog kukuruza i svežih paradajza sa farme svojih roditelja na sastanak sa biznismenom. Nakon ovog sastanka, postala je Bafetova finansijska asistentkinja i otišla je sa snage na snagu. 'Nameravam da angažujem mlađeg čoveka ili ženu sa potencijalom da upravlja veoma velikim portfeljem, za koga nadamo da će naslediti mene kao glavni investicioni direktor Berkshirea kada za to nastane potreba', napisao je Bafet u pismu akcionarima 2007. 'Kao deo procesa selekcije, mi zapravo možemo da primimo nekoliko kandidata.' U maju, Bafet je objavio na godišnjem sastanku akcionara Berkshire Hathaway da zna ko je njegov naslednik, ali je odbio da imenuje tu osobu ili osobe. Ali jedna stvar je sigurna: Trejsi Brit je namenjena za velika dela - posebno sa mentorom poput Bafeta. 'Kolege muškarci, ukrcajte se. Što bliže SAD dolazi da u potpunosti zaposli talente svih svojih građana, veća će biti njena proizvodnja robe i usluga', napisao je u Fortune magazinu. 'Videli smo šta se može postići kada koristimo 50 procenata našeg ljudskog kapaciteta. Ako vizuelizujete šta 100 procenata može da uradi, pridružićete mi se kao neukroćeni optimista u pogledu budućnosti Amerike.'
